Eh, I am getting old now, 67 years, so I cannot do all the work myself like before. This plot I intercrop my maize with beans and some groundnuts, it helps the soil and gives my wife something for relish. If the coupon comes through this year from the government, I will get my NPK and urea like always — without that subsidy the price at the trading centre is too much for me. I will use the hybrid seed from the coupon pack, but I also kept some local seed from last year in case the rains fail early. For weeding and ridging I will ask my son and one of my grandsons to help, and maybe hire two or three young men from the village for a few days when the weeds come heavy in January.
